highlights: UGREEN 50743  2.5" Hard Drive Enclosure USB C 3.1 Gen 2 to SATA III 6Gbps for SSD HDD 9.5 7mm External Hard Drive Disk Case with UASP Compatible with WD Seagate Toshiba Samsung Hitachi PS4 Xbox Router

Super Fast 6Gbps UASP: SATA interface supports max transfer speeds of up to 6Gbps and UASP accelerated transmission protocol. 70% Faster than traditional USB 3.0. Backward compatible with USB 2.0 and USB 1.1 ports.
2nd Gen USB 3.1 Port: Standard 2nd Gen USB C 3.1 with (7+15) Pin SATA III provides ultra-fast data transfer speeds of up to 6Gbps max. (Only USB-A to UAB-C Cable included)

Travel-Friendly External Storage: URGREEN hard drive enclosure connects your 2.5-inch SSD&HDD to a PC, laptop, game console, or router for easy data transfer. Get protection from scratches and data storage for SATA hard drives.

Easy Installation & Simple Design: No tools or drivers needed, simply plug and play setup. An LED indicator displays the working status. The attached EVA foam protects your hard disks from shaking and scratches. A flexible, detachable USB-C to USB-A cable (20-in) makes it easy to connect or pack away. (USB-C to USB-C cable is Not Included)

Universal Compatibility: UGREEN Hard Drive Enclosure supports Windows, LINUX, MacOS 8.0, and above. Specifically designed for 7/9.5mm thick, 2.5 inches, 6TB HDD & SSD. Compatible with Western Digital, Seagate, Toshiba, Samsung, Kingston, Crucial, Hitachi, and more.
